name: ATV Quad Bike Racing VR
summary:
Feel the dirt kick up behind you as you lean into the bars in **ATV Quad Bike Racing VR**, an arcade-realistic off-road VR racing game built for Meta Quest.

Every track feels different under your wheels. Grip through loose dirt, hold your line across mud and paved corners, feel every bump through the suspension on a rallycross-style mixed surface, and watch the dust trail behind you. A full field of AI riders brake late, fight for position, and never just hand you the win. Some tracks reward patience. Othe
